# KumbhLabs

> KumbhLabs is an R&D initiative for an AI-first Kumbh Mela, building for the Kumbh ecosystem beginning with the Nashik Simhastha Kumbh Mela 2027. Its flagship deployment is KumbhDoot, an open AI agent framework for every pilgrim.

Key facts:
- Focus: decentralized agentic AI, edge intelligence, personal AI agents, civic and population-scale intelligence.
- Architecture layers: Personal (edge agent), Ecosystem (interoperable providers), Population Intelligence (shared public rails).
- Proving ground: Kumbh Mela 2027, Nashik - a temporary city of tens of millions of people.
- Parent initiative: Project NANDA (https://projectnanda.org).
- Deployment: KumbhDoot (https://kumbhdoot.org).

## Pages
- [Home](https://kumbhlabs.org/): Overview, thesis, milestones, roadmap and system architecture.
- [KumbhDoot](https://kumbhlabs.org/kumbhdoot): The flagship AI agent framework, three-layer and sovereign agent architecture, team and contributors.
- [Research](https://kumbhlabs.org/research): Research areas and publications.
- [About](https://kumbhlabs.org/about): Who we are and the ecosystem around KumbhLabs.
- [Get Involved](https://kumbhlabs.org/get-involved): How researchers (working groups), startups (interest form) and industry partners/investors (contact@kumbhalabs.org) can join.
- [Blog](https://kumbhlabs.org/blog): Writing on agentic systems and population-scale infrastructure.
